svg.title: The playbook in use: five phases, four roles
svg.desc: What each role does in each phase, on one piece of work. Twenty cells, and between them the whole of what this playbook asks.

div.b: The playbook in use: five phases, four roles

div.span: What each role does in each phase, on one piece of work. Twenty cells, and between them the whole of what this playbook asks.
Owns the method, the checks and the write-up

div.div: Clarify the question with your commissioner, and score the assurance level with them.
Choose the method, plan the assurance the level asks for, and name your critical friend.
Do the work and your own checks, and record assumptions as you meet them.
Write it up with the caveats attached, and get the approval the level requires.
Record the lessons where the next analyst will look for them.

div.span: Independent advice on this one assignment

div.div: Understand the brief.
Review the plan, confirm you can do the assurance the level asks for, and put your own time in the schedule.
Run the checks the level requires, and report back.
State what you assured.
What you found is what the next piece of work avoids.

div.span: Owns the question and the decision it informs

div.div: State the decision the analysis supports and the deadline, and agree the assurance level with the analyst.
Approve the design before the work proceeds.
Stay available for the questions the work turns up.
Confirm the analysis meets the need you commissioned it for.
Ask whether it informed the decision, and whether it is still being used.
Be named, and confirm the register entry is made.
Confirm design governance has been followed.
Stay aware of progress.
Approve the work as fit for its intended use, after the Lead Assurer has signed off.
Revalidate the designation.

div.span: Read a row to see one role through the whole piece of work, and a column to see who is doing what at one moment. Level 1 work uses two of these rows: the analyst, and a colleague within the team as the critical friend. The fourth row applies only where the work is Business Critical.
NHSBSA Producing Quality Analysis Playbook. Service design artefacts for workshop use. Kainos Software Limited, SOW-DOC053.
